subject.title: [Bug]: When openclaw sends a link with an underscore to Feishu, the full hyperlink cannot be displayed

question: Should maintainers sponsor a fresh same-repository Feishu URL-boundary fix, or refresh one of the conflict-marked fork candidates for this issue?
rationale: The bug remains valid and narrow, but same-repository attempts are closed unmerged, fork candidates are conflict-marked, and the issue is already marked no-new-fix-pr.

options.title: Sponsor a fresh target-repo fix
options.body: Create or promote one narrow OpenClaw PR that fixes Feishu post URL rendering with regression tests and live Feishu proof.

options.title: Refresh a fork candidate
options.body: Pick the better open fork PR, resolve conflicts, and require focused tests plus live Feishu proof before merge.

options.title: Wait for contributor update
options.body: Keep the issue open without new automation until a contributor refreshes a mergeable candidate with proof.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a fresh target-repo fix
recommendation.body: Create or promote one narrow OpenClaw PR that fixes Feishu post URL rendering with regression tests and live Feishu proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Feishu send/outbound/post history makes this the strongest available current-code routing candidate for choosing the implementation path.
